day_shape: 61 items: IRIB relays Indian minister's claim of a missile strike on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Brent at $107, Trump confirms US eyeing Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site, IDF announces two October-7 Hamas commanders killed in Gaza, heavy Khamenei Nurses' Day message cycle.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker and oil price
threads.summary: IRIB cited India's Maritime Minister saying a tanker was targeted by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz, and reported Brent crude passing $107 per barrel approaching $108. Jerusalem Post also noted the absence of any Iranian or proxy claim of responsibility for the attempted hijacking of flydubai flight FZ1073.

threads.label: US eyes Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump confirmed the United States is considering Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site as a possible target for a future strike. Germany's foreign minister separately said Berlin will not tolerate Iran's hostile activities.

threads.label: IDF strikes on October 7 Hamas commanders
threads.summary: The IDF announced it killed Nukhba cell commander Maher Walid Omar al-Husseini in southern Gaza on Wednesday and Hamas weapons-production commander Mohammed Abd al-Khalek Hala, plus an Islamic Jihad operative, in northern Gaza on Thursday. Both named commanders took part in the October 7 attacks, including on the Re'im base.

threads.label: Interceptors over southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF launched interceptor missiles toward suspicious aerial targets over southern Lebanon in multiple incidents during the day, including two additional interceptors at a false target. No sirens sounded and no threat was reported to Israeli civilians.

threads.label: Khamenei Nurses' Day message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released the Supreme Leader's full message for the birth of Zaynab and Nurses' Day, with multiple excerpts on nurses as 'angels of mercy', the 'Zaynabi presence' of Iranian women, and the Ashura epic. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf, Judiciary head Ajeei and IRGC Navy commander Azmoayee issued accompanying Nurses' Day messages.

threads.label: Iran sanctions evasion and domestic repression
threads.summary: Reuters, cited by Jerusalem Post and Iran International, reported Iran shipped jet fuel to Myanmar and sent at least eight LPG tanker loads out of the Gulf since mid-July despite the US naval blockade. Iran International also reported HRANA figures of 34 actions against Baha'is in Yazd in seven months, a 50-lash sentence in Qom, and the execution of a 28-year-old Iraqi convicted of spying for Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: Iran-linked foreign operations and diplomacy
threads.summary: A UK court sentenced a Norwegian teenager, recruited by a Swedish crime group prosecutors link to the Iranian government, to 20 years for a murder plot. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson offered mediation between Saudi Arabia and Yemen, and Pezeshkian met Armenia's prime minister on a long-term economic cooperation programme.

events.title_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson: Iran is steadfast regarding Yemen and ready to help achieve a peaceful resolution of differences between Saudi Arabia and Yemen.
events.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson: Iran is steadfast regarding Yemen and ready to help achieve a peaceful resolution of differences between Saudi Arabia and Yemen. Iran is prepared, should both parties request it, to utilise its capacities to end the clashes. The past 12 years have shown that foreign intervention and blockade are not solutions. The Yemeni people have endured for years against a blockade designed by Britain and America; countries in the region must work to end this situation. Iran rejects claims of playing a role in Yemeni operations. Resolving the issue requires respect for Yemen's sovereignty, an end to interference, and a halt to air and sea blockades. Yemeni armed forces act according to their own interests. These claims are not credible.

events.title_en: Qalibaf: Parliament will pursue nurses' demands and economic obstacles. Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly issues message on Nurses' Day.
events.summary_en: Qalibaf: Parliament will pursue nurses' demands and economic obstacles. Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly issues message on Nurses' Day: Parliament pursues the concerns and legitimate demands of this dedicated community and, by removing economic obstacles, is a supporter and pillar for the esteemed nursing community of the country. The noble nurses of Islamic Iran are heirs to the same spirit that in the difficult days of the Sacred Defence and in times of crises and disasters displayed dazzling examples of sacrifice and responsibility. They who sometimes, in silence and without claim, forsake their comfort and peace so that the pulse of life beats in the hearts of their fellow citizens, deserve the highest levels of honour and appreciation.

events.title_en: Commander Azmoayee: Nurses are earthly angels who become a source of hope in the darkest moments. Commander of the Naval Force of the IRGC: Nurses' Day is more than a calendar occasion; it is an opportunity to appreciate the sacrifice and steadfastness of those who, on the frontline of healthcare, through effort and self-sacrifice, have drawn the line between life and death. Nurses who during the turbulent Ramadan War, amid dust of explosives and the sound of detonation, engaged in treating the wounded with unparalleled sacrifice, and during the difficult days of the twelve-day war, through steadfastness alongside fighters, displayed the splendour of resilience and have always been a source of pride for the nation and the history of the Islamic Revolution.

events.title: A Hamas terrorist who took part in the attack on the military's Re'im base during the October 7 onslaught was killed in an airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip earlier this week, the military announces. The strike on Wednesday killed Maher Walid Omar al-Husseini, the commander of a Nukhba Force cell in Hamas's military wing, the IDF says. The military says Husseini had invaded the Re'im base on October 7, 2023, and recently was advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and was attempting to restore Hamas's capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."
events.summary:

The military says Husseini had invaded the Re'im base on October 7, 2023, and recently was advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and was attempting to restore Hamas's capabilities, "in systematic violation of the ceasefire."

events.title: Norwegian teen gets 20-year sentence in UK murder plot linked to Iran

events.title: Iran shipped jet fuel to Myanmar despite US blockade - Reuters
events.summary: Iran managed to export jet fuel to Myanmar and send several shipments of liquefied petroleum gas out of the region despite a US naval blockade that has largely halted its crude exports, Reuters reported on Friday.

events.title_en: The hopeful role of nurses. The role of nurses in treating patients, unlike physicians, requires prolonged, sustained, and patient presence. The impact of such presence goes beyond physical matters and will be a balm for spiritual and psychological suffering, and will prevent despair from taking hold in many cases. Excerpt from the Supreme Leader's message on the occasion of the birth of Zaynab (peace be upon her) and Nurses' Day | 24 Mehr 1405.

events.title: Iran speaker says government overstepped on anti-terror finance rules

events.title_en: Nurses; angels of mercy and hope. Complete text of the Supreme Leader's message on the occasion of the birth of Zaynab (may God's prayers be upon her) and Nurses' Day. His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message on the occasion of the anniversary of the birth of Zaynab (may God's prayers be upon her) and Nurses' Day, described the role of Zaynabi women and girls of Islamic Iran during the unparalleled era of the Iranian nation as remarkable, and, referring to the revitalising and hopeful role of nurses and their important impact on the health and physical and spiritual security of society, recommended healthcare officials to pay special attention to the nursing community.

events.title: A Hamas commander who participated in the October 7 onslaught and a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative were killed in separate strikes in the Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. One strike on Thursday in northern Gaza killed Mohammed Mohammed Abd al-Khalek Hala, identified by the IDF as a Hamas commander in the terror group's weapons production division, who also invaded Israel on October 7, 2023. The military says Hala produced various weapons and advanced "the military buildup of the terror group across the Gaza Strip." A separate strike on Thursday in southern Gaza's Khan Younis killed Ahmad Jabrin Tawfiq Dalha, a member of the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, according to the IDF. B
